text: Accept only a registered source's room, valid finite numeric temperature and well-formed timestamp/sequence; preserve occurrence and receipt times separately.
criteria: Wrong-room credentials, NaN-like/non-numeric values and malformed sequences are rejected without changing state.

text: Apply duplicate/out-of-order/gap policy deterministically per room; emit at most one OPEN incident while one remains unresolved.
criteria: Replay/lower sequences and concurrent duplicates do not increment twice; a gap resets the consecutive run.

text: Open an incident after three consecutive accepted high observations and retain their identifying evidence.
criteria: ROOM-A opens one incident with three trigger references; ROOM-B remains without one.

text: Only assigned technicians or a supervisor may acknowledge/resolve; resolution requires a nonblank action note.
criteria: Unassigned technician or blank resolution fails; authorized resolution retains actor/action/time.

text: Mark a room STALE after five minutes without an accepted observation; stale is a data-quality state, not a claim about physical safety.
criteria: Advance beyond five minutes with no sample: STALE; a valid newer observation clears data staleness.

text: With 20 rooms reporting once per second for five minutes, process nominal incident triggers within 30 seconds and retain correct per-room state.
criteria: Execute the stated 6000-observation workload and compare final state with an independent deterministic reference calculation.
